name: print-social-swiss-poster-project-about-text-on-black
title: About-the-project text slide on black with orange heading and three-dot key
whatItIs: A near-black slide with cropped poster edges at the top, an orange uppercase 'ABOUT THE PROJECT' heading over a white rule, two staggered columns of white body text about Swiss style and a 50-poster set, and three small circles (striped, white, orange) at the lower left.
whatItMeans: Quiet and confident; strictly limited colours echo the constraints described in the text.
techniques: Stagger two text columns at different heights.
Use one orange for the heading and a swatch dot.
Show a tiny palette key of circles.
Crop poster edges into the frame for context.

vocabulary.definition: Small circles showing the colours used.
A thin line under a heading.
